messages:
Evan (Sales): Quick handoff for Clearwater Labs. Mid-market, signed 2024-08-15, 12mo. Running on a dedicated eval in us-east. Onboarding ~58%. Two immediate blockers: SSO failing (Okta cert mismatch -> 502 during auth) and bulk ingest failing with 5xx. Renewal risk: medium if not stabilized in 30d.

Priya (CS): I will own onboarding + enablement. Can we get Sam/Lee contact and a sanitized CSV + IdP metadata XML? Planning an enablement Wed 11:00 ET.

Evan (Sales): Contacts: sam@class.clearwater (Platform Lead), lee@class.clearwater (PM). Sam ok to drop files in shared folder. Sending intro now.

Mateo (Eng): Reproduced Okta tls error: "certificate signed by unknown authority". ENG-8020 opened. Fix is config update + restart of dedicated host; no code change. Need metadata XML or cert.

Jules (Support): I'll create SUPPORT-3600, add ingest synthetic monitor, alert if 5xx >1% over 5m. Assign to oncall + Mateo.

infra-bot: Maintenance queued for host clearwater-ded-01. Queue position: 2. Please confirm ETA in ENG-8020.

Priya (CS): Owners & next steps:
- Priya: lead onboarding + run Wed 11:00 ET enablement; capture feedback on routing/costs.
- Mateo: ENG-8020, prepare config change and restart plan; will coordinate with infra.
- Jules: SUPPORT-3600 + monitors; triage ingest after sample.
- Evan: customer liaison; confirm uploads and maintenance window.

Evan (Sales): Sam replied: uploading IdP metadata + sanitized CSV. Maintenance window Tue 16:00-17:00 ET; requests 20m pre-call.

Mateo (Eng): I can do restart Tue 16:10 ET post pre-call. Will post PR & health checks to ENG-8020.

Jules (Support): Standing by during restart; will open incident if 5xx >2%. SUPPORT-3600 created.

Priya (CS): I'll create Jira epic CS-1407 and link ENG-8020 + SUPPORT-3600. Scheduling pre-call Tue 15:40 ET. Will share short feedback form after enablement.

Evan (Sales): Marking renewal in CRM as "monitoring" and setting 30-day adoption check (tokens/day). Ping here for quick updates. :thumbsup:
